candidate: codex/core-logs-ci-performance working tree before PR commit

scope.data: Synthetic loopback fixture, four engines; alpha/bravo/charlie scopes. Long messages repeat 80 times, short messages repeat zero times. Both versions served by the same candidate fixture.
scope.backendLimitation: Fixture validators are synthetic and bypass body construction when unchanged. Production computes content SHA256 after permission checks and SQL/JSON work, so these results establish transport/browser savings, not lower database cost or production TTFB.
scope.byteDefinition: Encoded/decoded HTTP response body bytes; excludes HTTP request/response headers and TLS framing. 304 still has headers.
scope.measurementDefinition: Actions include two requestAnimationFrame turns after the relevant UI state. Changed refresh waits for the first displayed row key to change after server completion. Unchanged sample waits for three browser-consumed 200 bodies or 304 responses and two frames.
scope.bodyAndJSONMs: Includes body streaming, decompression and JSON parsing wait; not exclusive CPU parse time.
scope.cache: Short snapshots fit the 16 MiB cache and show 200 rows synchronously on return. Long 8000-entry snapshots exceed that budget and correctly show zero synchronous cached rows.
scope.sampling: One final observation per case on a shared host, not percentile guarantees; earlier exploratory runs are excluded.
scope.phaseAggregation: Phase calls are aggregated as calls/totalMs/maxMs per sampling window; phase durations may be nested and must not be summed as exclusive CPU time. Full per-call raw output remains in output/playwright/*-final.txt.
